Flags const or pure functions that transitively call known non-const functions.

# Purpose
This CodeQL query searches C++ code for functions marked with the `pure` or `const` attribute that call known non-`const` and non-`pure` functions through direct or transitive calls. It defines `PureFunc` and `ConstFunc` as special cases of `Function`, then matches any `RFunc` that reaches one of the named target functions `fd_log_private_1`, `fd_log_private_2`, or `fd_log_wallclock()`. The query reports a warning when such a call path exists, so it is a narrow static analysis rule for finding attribute violations in code that should avoid side effects.
